-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.MemstorageApi` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def memStorInv [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ :
    Cluster) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  memStorInvP ms γs (memStorJ γ id)

def memStorJ [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) : MemJust GF :=
  { SV := snapshotValid γ, B := fun k => iprop(nodeAppliedLb γ id k ∨ snapGiven γ id k), DL := storDL γ id, SV_pers := ⋯,
    B_pers := ⋯, B_timeless := ⋯, DL_pers := ⋯ }

theorem memStorage_isStorage [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (wp_LastIndex :
    MemoryStorage.LastIndex.spec) (wp_FirstIndex : MemoryStorage.FirstIndex.spec) (wp_Term :
    MemoryStorage.Term.spec) (wp_Entries : MemoryStorage.Entries.spec) (wp_Snapshot :
    MemoryStorage.Snapshot.spec) (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) : ⊢
    memStorInv ms γs γ id -∗ memStorReg ms γs -∗ isStorage γ id (memStorIface ms)

theorem memStorInv_persistent [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) : Persistent (memStorInv ms γs γ id)

theorem memStorInv_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames)
    (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ memStorLock ms γs -∗ memStorFresh ms γs ={E}=∗
    memStorInv ms γs γ id
